content:
Priya Patel: Hey team — AcmeCorp is moving a POC to the final review. They want: SOC 2 artifacts (attestation + supporting summary), a signed pen-test letter for the POC window, staging creds with IP allowlist for our sandbox, and a ballpark for 1 month of Dedicated capacity (they may purchase). Need everything by Wed EOD their timezone. Any blockers?

Mateo Cruz: Do we know what level of artifacts they expect? full SOC2 report, or the public attestation + control summary?

Priya Patel: They asked for `SOC 2` artifacts and said "evidence to satisfy our security team" — they haven't specified full report vs summary. leaning towards attestation + evidence index first.

Jen Park: We can provide the SOC 2 Type II attestation PDF and an internal evidence index (redacted). We do NOT share raw logs or full internal change history. I'll attach the pack: `SOC2_Attestation_2024.pdf` and `evidence_index_redwood_2024.csv` to the secure share. Link: https://internal.redwood.com/share/soc2-2024 (access req'd).

Alex Li: For the pen-test letter: we have a standard template (legal-reviewed) that covers scope, timeframe, rules of engagement, and point of contact. We sign the letter once scope is agreed and tickets for staging creds are opened. If Acme wants special clauses (e.g., data export, exploit disclosure), send redlines asap — legal turnaround ~48 hours for minor edits.

Evan Chen: Staging creds: we require a ticket to infra with customer IPs (CIDR) for the allowlist. We can provision a scoped service account and ephemeral API token that expires after the POC window. Steps: 1) customer provides IP list + contact, 2) we create project `acme-poc-staging`, 3) we provision `svc-redwood-poc-acme` with `read+infer` role, 4) create token with TTL = 30d (or custom). Example service account name: `svc-poc-acme-2024`.

Mateo Cruz: Also flagging: if they plan to run their own red team on our POC infra, we need explicit scope in the pen-test letter + a signed attestation on handling findings. We can offer a red-team attestation (we'll provide a one-page acknowledgment that we accept external testing under agreed scope) but we won't share internal vuln details beyond remediation confirmation.

Priya Patel: Pricing question — can someone give a quick ballpark for 1 month Dedicated (1x A100 equivalent, baseline config) vs hosted overage? The buyer needs a figure to move the purchase committee.

Mateo Cruz: Ballpark: Dedicated (reserved monthly single node, A100-class) ~ $20k/mo list, with discounts for 3/6/12mo commits. Hosted for POC (bursting) depends on token/throughput; rough parity if low qps but Dedicated is predictable for load testing. I'll caveat that exact number depends on seq len and sustained qps.

Alex Li: Pricing notes: if they want private deployment or specific data residency, that's a license + setup fee; include that in the quote if they mention VPC/on‑prem. Also ask procurement for PO terms — legal will review SLA addendum if they request it.

Jen Park: One security blocker to call out — Acme asked whether we can provide penetration test attestation from our third‑party pen-test vendor. We can provide the pen-test attestation letter (signed) that says we had a test and remediation summary. We do not provide raw pen-test reports or vendor notes. If they require vendor CVs or detailed findings, escalate to legal/account.

Evan Chen: For the infra ticket — please include: customer contact, IPs, required roles, start/end dates for token, and whether they need streaming/websocket access. Ping me once ticket is open and I’ll accelerate.

Priya Patel: Great — actionable next steps: Jen, can you drop the SOC2 attestation + evidence index to the secure share and confirm any redactions by EOD today? Alex, can you attach the pen-test letter template and note turnaround? Mateo/Evan: can you craft the POC Dedicated rough quote + infra ticket template? I’ll send to Acme and ask them to confirm scope.

Jen Park: On it. I uploaded files and left redaction notes in the share. :white_check_mark:

Alex Li: Pen-test template uploaded to the same secure folder. I’ll pre-fill contact as `security@redwood.com`. Turnaround estimate: 48h if no major redlines.

Mateo Cruz: I’ll put together a 1-pager quote and example performance assumptions (seq len, qps, expected tokens). Evan — sending infra ticket template in 5.

Evan Chen: Ticket template posted in thread. Use snippet: ```Customer: AcmeCorp
Contact: name/email
IPs: x.x.x.x/32,...
Project: acme-poc-staging
Service account: svc-poc-acme-YYYY
Roles: read+infer
Token TTL: 30d
Start: 2024-06-10
End: 2024-07-10``` I’ll triage after ticket creation.

Priya Patel: Thanks everyone. If Acme confirms running an external red team we’ll loop Legal & Security for a quick sync. Will update here after I hear back. :pray:

Mateo Cruz: ack.

Jen Park: ack.

Alex Li: ack.

Evan Chen: ack.
